title: Delivery times
text: Estimated delivery times are shown in the app. Delays caused by weather or traffic do not qualify for compensation.

title: Address changes
text: The delivery address can be changed until the rider picks up the order. After pickup, address changes are not possible.

title: Refund eligibility
text: Refunds are issued to the original payment method. Coupons and delivery fees are not refundable.

title: Refund window
text: A refund must be requested within 7 days of delivery. After 7 days, an order is no longer eligible for a refund.

title: Missing or damaged items
text: If an item is missing or damaged, we refund the price of that item. A photo may be requested for damaged items.

title: Large refunds
text: Any refund above ₹500 requires approval by a human support agent.

title: Cold food
text: If food arrives cold, the customer can receive a one-time 20% coupon for the next order. Cold food is not refunded in cash.

title: Coupons
text: Only one coupon can be applied per order. Coupons cannot be exchanged for cash.
